summary: S09 covered the wiring that lets a TrueVision drawing module run inside ValeVision: entry HTML, the CSS index, VV's lazy Layout Editor loader, 01/02/03 core folders, the service worker, the window-event catalogue, project-data overlay keys, local-server routes and the two verify harnesses (both run: VV ModuleGraph exit 0 / 517 modules, VV Exports PASS 415; TV ModuleGraph exit 1 on a known string false positive, TV Exports PASS 542). Import maps are identical. The top-bar fold Adam named is already a verbatim port (TV v2.83.0 to VV v2.70.0); the remaining UI gap is the loading screen versus TV's veil, plus TV's compact tab strip and Share button. Five structural wiring facts govern every port. (1) VV loads the editor lazily through a facade loader, and TV's TabStrip 2.0.0 and DevMenu need new facade calls. (2) TV's 40-55 modules carry 141 import specifiers into drawing folders whose numbers differ, and TV 47 DrawingPlanes collides with VV 47 NorthDirection. (3) TV drawing modules import 72 shared names VV lacks: 21 CfApi, 8 LocalProjectMirror, 7 KeyScope, 14 PhaseLibrary, InteractiveOverlays and others. Same-name VV transport shims (the R2AssetUpload precedent) are recommended. (4) VV's index attaches the drawings, section-scene and DrawCfg listeners after the loading sequence (TV fixed this race), and VV initialises Transitions (1.4 s flights) where TV never does. (5) VV's 3D hotkey handler has no tab-scope gate (TV v2.110.0 KeyScope), so drawing-tab keys very likely also drive the hidden 3D view. Also found TV-side faults the swarm must not copy over VV's working code: a dead na-pm-scene-activated listener, no na-model-visibility-changed dispatcher, and CrossSection__SceneData on none of TV's three dev-owned key lists. The shared WCP service-worker token has not been bumped since v2.67 (Adam's call). The report holds a 13-step integration checklist, an event catalogue (75 TV / 64 VV events), a shared-import surface table, 11 decisions and 14 work packages.

findings.title: Drawing folder numbering forces 141+ import rewrites per full port; TV 47 collides with VV 47
findings.detail: Under the section 4.1 map (TV 40/42/43/44/45/46 -> VV 42/43/44/45/46/47), TV's 40-55 modules carry 381 cross-folder specifiers. 141 of them target a drawing folder whose number differs; 11 target 41, a different engine in VV; 19 target TV-only 47/48/49. TV 47__System__DrawingPlanes has no VV home because VV 47 is NorthDirection. Every whole-file port, and every TV Na__Test__* that loads sources by path, needs hand rewrites. The established files that also move are index.html, 01 LoadingSequence, four 21 PresentationMode modules and 30 ImageExport.
findings.recommendation: Decide D-S09-02. Preferred: one serialised VV renumber early (42->40, 43->42, 44->43, 45->44, 46->45, 47->46, after moving or retiring legacy 40 2dElevationsView), gated by both harnesses. TV files then port with unchanged paths, and 47/48/49 slot in. Until then, apply the checklist's path translation step.
findings.evidence: work_s09/cross_folder_imports.py: TV 381 specifiers / 150 files; targets 40x81, 44x21, 42x13, 45x13, 43x8, 46x5, 47x10, 49x7, 48x2. TV plan section 4.1 fixed the map on 10-Sep-2026.

findings.title: TV-only top-level folders imported by drawing modules have no VV home
findings.detail: TV drawing and Layout Editor modules import TV-only top-level folders: 27 ContextMenuSystem (2), 47 DrawingPlanes (10), 48 CrossSectionViews (2), 49 ElevationDepthFog (7), 52 Layout__PublishedDocuments (4), 53 Data__Layout__PublishedSchema (12), 54 ColourPalette (2), 55 SpellCheck (1) and 80 CloudflareIntegration (16). VV has none of them. The numbers 47 and 80 matter: 47 is VV NorthDirection, and 80 holds TV's transport client.
findings.recommendation: Give each a VV home before its importers land: 52/53/54/55 at the same numbers (free in VV), 27 if adopted, 47/48/49 after D-S09-02. Put a same-name transport shim at 80__CloudflareIntegration (D-S09-04).
findings.evidence: cross_folder_imports.py by-target counts; reverse_imports.py; TV tree lists these folders and VV has none.

findings.title: jsPDF still lives in legacy 35 PageLayoutSystem; TV moved it to the version-locked vendor folder
findings.detail: TV v2.155.0 (Phase 0) retired 90__System__PageLayoutSystem and moved jsPDF 4.1.0 to 04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked/05__Vendor__JsPdf__v4.1.0 and html2canvas 1.4.1 to 06__Vendor__Html2Canvas__v1.4.1. VV's LE config still loads jsPDF from 35__System__PageLayoutSystem/01__Dependencies__VersionLocked/jspdf.umd.js. The content is identical ignoring CR. The VV version-lock index is named Vale__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index__.json. This coupling blocks retiring VV's legacy 35.
findings.recommendation: Copy jspdf.umd.js to VV 04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked/05__Vendor__JsPdf__v4.1.0/. Update LayoutEditor__Pdf__JsPdfScriptPath (LE AppConfig JSON:402) and the SheetSetup fallback (:396), and record it in the Vale version-lock index and README. Add 06 html2canvas when the Statement Writer lands.
findings.evidence: TV LE AppConfig:498 and SheetSetup:553 vs VV AppConfig:402 and SheetSetup:396; TV devlog v2.155.0 Phase 0 (line ~1288); both files report version 4.1.0.

findings.title: SnapshotHistory file name differs (TV no suffix, VV double-underscore suffix)
findings.detail: The logic is identical (TV 1.0.0, ported verbatim). VV renamed the file to Na__AppUtils__SnapshotHistory__.js on purpose. TV 43 PlanAnnotations History and 44 PlanDimensions History import the TV name, so a verbatim port breaks on the import.

findings.title: Layout Editor key file renamed in TV (Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json) and grown; document-tab key file missing
findings.detail: TV v2.115.0 renamed Na__LayoutEditor__KeyMappings__.json to Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json (one file per kind of tab). ConfigState__KeyMap__ 1.11.0 fetches the new name; VV 1.0.0 fetches the old one. The schema is the same (identical 11 top blocks). TV-only LE/31__System__DocumentKeys/Na__Hotkeys__DocumentTabs__.json serves the document tabs.
findings.recommendation: Rename the VV file to Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json with TV's content in the same WP as the ConfigState__KeyMap__ port. Port 31__System__DocumentKeys (file and JSON) with the document tabs. Keep VV's 3D dictionary as it is.
findings.evidence: work_s09/hotkeys_diff.py: same top keys, TV +3 leaves; TV KeyMap:152 vs VV KeyMap:63; TV devlog v2.115.0 Files list.

findings.title: VV attaches the drawings, section-scene and DrawCfg listeners after the loading sequence starts (latent race TV fixed)
findings.detail: TV Index.html:1556-1570 calls Na__DrawView__ProjectData__Initialize, Na__SectionCut__SceneData__Initialize and Na__DrawCfg__SetAppConfig/Load before StartLoadingSequence (1576), with a comment explaining why: the drawings block is dispatched exactly once (TV commit 2712872f; v2.30.2 for DrawCfg). VV calls ProjectData at 2209, DrawCfg at 2207-2208 and Na__SectSceneData__Initialize (inside InitializeCrossSectionControls, 2156), all after StartLoadingSequence at 1966. VV survives only because the dispatch sits behind awaits.
findings.recommendation: Move those calls above Na__AppFlow__StartLoadingSequence in VV index.html, mirroring TV 1535-1571 and its comments. Add a direct, idempotent Na__SectSceneData__Initialize() call there. Keep DrawCfg__Load un-awaited.
findings.evidence: TV Index.html:1544-1571 vs VV index.html:1966, 2156, 2207-2209; VV 41 Controls:288; SceneData:446-448 is idempotent.

findings.title: DevGate initialised after the dev surfaces in VV (before them in TV)
findings.detail: TV resolves the authoring gate at Index.html:1541 ("must precede every dev surface"). VV calls Na__DevGate__Initialize at 2261, after the scene inspector, the cross-section dev controls, the presentation scene editor and the North DevMenu. This is functionally safe because IsAuthoringEnabled resolves lazily and applies ?authoring= (DevGate:175-193). Only the console helpers window.Na__DevGate__Unlock/Lock appear later.
findings.recommendation: Move the VV call above the loading sequence, next to TV's position, in the same edit as S09-F07.
findings.evidence: TV Index.html:1536-1541; VV index.html:2255-2261; DevGate 1.1.0 is identical apart from names.

findings.title: Drawing entry differs: TV never initialises Transitions (instant, controllers own OrbitControls); VV flies 1.4 s
findings.detail: TV 40/Na__DrawView__Transitions__.js 1.1.0 says Initialize is still called by nobody, so FlyTo lands at once, and this is deliberate. TV instead passes controls to Na__FloorPlanMode__Initialize and Na__ElevationMode__Initialize, which disable OrbitControls themselves (TV FloorPlan ModeController:313/326). VV calls Na__DrawView__Transitions__Initialize({camera, controls}) at 2210 and passes no controls to either mode controller. VV therefore flies DrawingView__Config__TransitionIntoMs/OutOfMs (1400 ms). This visible UX difference conflicts with an identical experience.
findings.recommendation: Decide D-S09-05. To follow TV: stop calling Transitions__Initialize, pass controls to both mode controllers when their TV versions land, and drop or keep the VV Transition keys as unused. Adam may prefer the flights instead.
findings.evidence: TV Transitions:53-70 (Initialize called by nobody); TV Index.html:1676-1690 and 1755-1768 pass controls; VV index.html:2210-2247; VV Main config DrawingView__Config TransitionIntoMs 1400.

findings.title: Layout Editor loading: TV eager at start-up, VV lazy behind the loader facade
findings.detail: TV Index.html:901-904 imports the mode controller, tab strip, Dev menu and share opener, and initialises them at 1719-1738. VV imports only LE/01__Core__Loader/Na__LayoutEditor__Loader__.js (index.html:1442, init 2274-2283). The loader offers the editor (Layout Mode on plus at least one sheet), imports the tab strip lazily, imports the editor and links 8 stylesheets behind a loading screen on first use, and answers both UIs before the load. Every TV start-up entry point into the editor must therefore be reached through the facade. The ledger contradicts itself on whether this is a back-port candidate.
findings.recommendation: Decide D-S09-01. Recommended: keep the loader as a recorded permanent VV seam (it keeps ~73 modules and 1.9 MB off start-up), extend the facade per TV entry point, and offer the back-port to TV.
findings.evidence: VV Loader:13-37, 125-134, 244-253; TV Index.html:1719-1738; ledger lines 1230 and 1244 disagree.

findings.title: Loader facade lacks the entry points TV's TabStrip 2.0.0 and DevMenu need
findings.detail: TV TabStrip 2.0.0 (v2.158.0; PORT NOTE: back-port PENDING to VV) imports ConfigState, SheetModel (incl. IsSitePlanSheet), ModeController (Ready, VIEW_REGISTER, VIEW_STATEMENT, OpenRegister, OpenStatements) and SpecData directly. VV's TabStrip 1.5.0 uses 22 Na__LeLoad__ facade names. TV's DevMenu imports KIND_2D/3D, Na__LeVp3d__Bake, Na__LeSource__Resolve (20 ModelSource) and Na__LePdf__ExportSheet. VV's DevMenu reaches the editor via GetEditor/Require. The facade has no register or statement views and no OpenRegister/OpenStatements/IsSitePlanSheet/Ready.
findings.recommendation: Add Na__LeLoad__VIEW_REGISTER='register', VIEW_STATEMENT='statement', OpenRegister, OpenStatements, IsSitePlanSheet (pre-load from Sheet__DrawingType) and Ready, plus CheckNames rows. In the DevMenu port, route TV's direct calls through editor.model/viewport3d/pdf after Require, or grow the loader's ImportEditor list.
findings.evidence: TV TabStrip:1-140 imports; TV ModeController:423-431 and 1272-1289 exports; VV TabStrip imports only the loader; VV Loader:112-117, 284-295.

findings.title: VV-only ModeController API and listeners must be re-applied on any whole-file port of TV's ModeController
findings.detail: TV ModeController 1.32.0 exports no WaitForFirstDrawing, IsAvailable, IsLayoutModeOn or SetLayoutMode (TV:1272-1289). VV 1.18.0 exports all four (VV:888-902), and the loader depends on them for its loading screen and Layout Mode. VV's ModeController also listens to na-presentation-mode-scenes-loaded/cleared (the Add Viewport refresh, VV v2.45.1); TV's does not. TV's file imports 76 modules, including every TV-only feature; VV's imports 51.
findings.recommendation: Treat the ModeController as port_whole_reapply_vv only after all its imported features exist in VV. Until then each feature WP adds its own import, Ready and init lines (serialised hot file). Always re-apply the four VV exports and the scenes listeners, and record them in the PORT NOTE Divergences.
findings.evidence: TV ModeController:1193 ready chain of 11 readies and 76 imports; VV ModeController:828 (6 readies), 888-902; event_catalogue VV-only listeners.

findings.title: Loader-boundary seams in SheetRecords (DrawingCode leaf) and RenameDrawing (facade restamp)
findings.detail: VV-only LE/07__Core__SheetData/Na__LayoutEditor__DrawingCode__.js holds the D03-code rules with no imports, so the facade can name tabs before the editor loads. VV SheetRecords imports and re-exports it; TV keeps the same functions inside SheetRecords 1.39.0. VV 42/Na__DrawView__RenameDrawing__.js imports Na__LeLoad__PrepareRestamp/RestampForScene; TV's dynamically imports Viewport3d.
findings.recommendation: When porting TV SheetRecords__ or RenameDrawing__ whole, keep importing the DrawingCode leaf (re-export under Na__LeRec__ names) and keep the facade restamp calls. List both in the PORT NOTE Divergences.
findings.evidence: VV DrawingCode:12-41; VV RenameDrawing:121; TV RenameDrawing:130 dynamic import of Viewport3d.

findings.title: Late-start semantics: ported LE modules must not rely on hearing the first drawings-loaded event
findings.detail: In VV the editor loads after na-layouteditor-drawingsdata-loaded has fired. The loader re-announces only na-layouteditor-sheets-changed {reason:'loaded'} (Loader:307-311). TV LE modules listening to the raw event at init (today TV LE/54 SheetImages:147, a reset) never hear the first dispatch in VV. Unsaved browser drafts must also come back whichever arrives first, which is what TV v2.145.0 fixed.
findings.recommendation: Each ported LE module initialises from current state (Na__DrawData__GetSheetsArray, Na__LeModel__GetSheets) or from the re-announced change. Port TV Na__Test__DraftRestore__ and Na__Test__SheetsNormaliseOnce__ as acceptance tests for the loader path.
findings.evidence: VV Loader:299-311; TV SheetImages:59,147; event_catalogue: TV LOADED listeners are ProjectData plus SheetImages, VV's are ProjectData plus SheetModel.

findings.title: Loader STYLESHEETS list must gain TV's eagerly imported LE sheets, in TV cascade order
findings.detail: TV's CSS index imports 14 LE sheets (161-174). VV's loader links 8 (Surfaces first, WebViewer last). Missing as TV features land: DraftMode, DrawingGrid, ObjectSnap and DrawingAxes (after Main__Paper); SheetImages and Share (after Specification__Read). Self-linking TV sheets need no registration: Patterns, VectorTools, ScrapbookParametric/Custom/Specification, FloorAreas, DrawingRegister, Statement x2.
findings.recommendation: Each feature WP adds its sheet to Na__LeLoad__STYLESHEETS at TV's position and never adds an entry for a file that has not landed. WebViewer stays last. Do not add LE sheets to VV's CSS index.
findings.evidence: TV CSS index:161-174; VV Loader:125-134; self-link sites, e.g. TV 37 Panel__VectorTools:376, 51 Register__Editor:596.

findings.title: Tab-strip CSS lives in TV Styles__Main__.css but in VV's Boot sheet
findings.detail: TV keeps every .na-le-tabs rule in LE/10__Core__SheetSurface/Na__LayoutEditor__Styles__Main__.css (26 matches), and TV v2.158.0 changed the strip and that sheet together. VV moved the published height, tab strip, Dev-section sheet list and loading screen to LE/01__Core__Loader/Na__LayoutEditor__Styles__Boot__.css (20 matches) because the strip shows before the editor loads. A whole-file port of TV's Main sheet would leave the strip unstyled before first load and double-defined after.
findings.recommendation: On every Styles__Main__ port, move the tab-strip region (including the v2.158.0 compact strip and Drawings menu rules) into Boot and delete it from Main. Verify the strip before and after the first editor load.
findings.evidence: grep .na-le-tabs: TV Main 26, VV Boot 20 and Main 1; VV Boot PORT NOTE lines 4-8.

findings.title: CSS index: 54/55 must be eager; two ordering differences to verify
findings.detail: TV imports 54 ColourPalette (182) and 55 SpellCheck (190) eagerly; the palette is used by the 3D-tab PlanAnnotations toolbar as well as LE PanelHost. VV has neither. Order: VV imports DevToolsMenu last (VV:112) where TV puts it after AppHeader (TV:53) to override dropdown geometry, and VV puts DrawView DevMenu first in the drawing group (VV:85) where TV puts it after PlanDimensions (TV:149). The selectors are scoped, so a visible clash is unproven.
findings.recommendation: Add the 54/55 sheets to VV's CSS index when those modules land, in TV's position. Align or record the two ordering choices after a visual check of the Dev menu.
findings.evidence: TV CSS index:53,149,182,190; VV CSS index:85,112; TV 43 PlanAnnotations__Toolbar imports 54.

findings.title: Project-data dispatch contract differs; VV must keep its own
findings.detail: TV dispatches na-layouteditor-drawingsdata-loaded unconditionally after the scenes, with {block, sceneConfig, projectCode}; sceneConfig drives TV-only legacy migration. VV dispatches it before the scenes with {block, projectCode}. TV dispatches na-crosssection-scenedata-loaded unconditionally with {block}; VV dispatches only when present, with {sceneData}. VV also dispatches crosssection-config/sketchup-sections and render-engine-loaded. TV calls Na__CfApi__SetLoadedProjectData(full) as the save merge base; VV saves re-fetch from Flask.
findings.recommendation: Never port LoadingSequence whole. Keep VV's dispatch keys and order, and adapt any TV module that reads detail.sceneConfig or the section detail.block. Add only new seams (S09-F20, S09-F21).
findings.evidence: TV LoadingSequence:925, 959-968, 976-980; VV LoadingSequence:704-738.

findings.title: na-app-scene-ready is never dispatched in VV
findings.detail: TV LoadingSequence:443 dispatches na-app-scene-ready at the end of ShowScene. It is heard by LE/66 Share__Open__ (waits for the model before an author's editor opens a shared document), the TV index fullscreen prompt, the PWA install controller and AssetCull dev controls. VV's ShowScene (474-497) clears the LoadWatchdog but dispatches nothing.
findings.recommendation: Add one dispatch at the end of VV Na__UiFeature__ShowScene, before any 66 DocumentSharing port.
findings.evidence: TV LoadingSequence:443; TV Share__Open__:98,166-168,321; VV LoadingSequence:474-497.

findings.title: Render-loop hooks TV features need in VV's loading sequence, composer and thumbnail renderer
findings.detail: TV's drawing branch renders scene, DrawProfile, ElevFog (49), SectionCut and DrawMarkup; a held engine returns early via Na__RenderLoop__IsPaused; the 3D path brackets frames with Na__InteractiveOverlays__BeginFrame/EndFrame. VV's branch is ComposerPreset__RenderFrame, DrawMarkup and PlOverlay (DIV-1). TV v2.94.0 lists the fog integration as RenderPreset, LoadingSequence and Thumbnail__Renderer (one import, one call each).
findings.recommendation: When 49 lands, add the fog overlay to VV's drawing branch, to ComposerPreset offscreen bakes and to 21 Thumbnail__Renderer. When 46/47 move to InteractiveOverlays, add Begin/EndFrame to VV's 3D path. Keep ComposerPreset.
findings.evidence: TV LoadingSequence:1144,1170-1181,1189,1447; VV LoadingSequence:1316-1330; TV devlog v2.94.0 Files.

findings.title: 05 RenderPipeline: InteractiveOverlays module and Invalidation IsPaused missing in VV
findings.detail: TV-only 05/Na__RenderLoop__InteractiveOverlays__.js 1.0.0 (20-Sep-2026, 'ValeVision: not yet ported') keeps authoring overlays invisible outside the interactive 3D frame. It is used by TV 46 North CompassGizmo and 47 DrawingPlanes Overlay. TV Invalidation exports Na__RenderLoop__IsPaused, used by the 47 Grip; TV pauses through a reason set. VV Invalidation 1.1.0 pauses through na-pause/resume-render-loop events and has no IsPaused.
findings.recommendation: Port InteractiveOverlays verbatim with the Begin/EndFrame hooks. Add Na__RenderLoop__IsPaused to VV Invalidation by tracking hold reasons beside the existing events, without changing VV's LoadingSequence listener.
findings.evidence: shared_import_surface.py: 4 InteractiveOverlays names and IsPaused missing; TV Invalidation:49-73; VV Invalidation:88-102.

findings.title: DistanceCulling path differs (VV MaxEngine subfolder)
findings.detail: TV keeps Na__RenderEffect__DistanceCulling__.js directly under 05__RenderPipeline (one pipeline). VV keeps it under 05__RenderPipeline/02__Engine__MaxEngine/ because of its Pure/Max engine split. VV exports the same IsEnabled and SetEnabled. TV 40 Transitions and the 42/45 ModeControllers import the TV path. TV's Transitions PORT NOTE already records this.
findings.recommendation: Keep VV's path, and re-point the import in every ported TV module (checklist step 1).
findings.evidence: TV Transitions PORT NOTE:38-40; VV Transitions:58-63; VV DistanceCulling exports include IsEnabled/SetEnabled.

findings.title: Design phases (PhaseLibrary) required by TV LE Model Source; VV has none
findings.detail: TV 26/Na__ModelGroup__PhaseLibrary__.js 1.0.0 (v2.32.0, 'Existing and Proposed on one sheet') supplies 14 names to LE ModelSource, SnapshotRenderer, ViewportIdentity and ModeController, plus na-model-phase-library-changed. It is initialised in TV LoadingSequence:714. VV projects have no design-phase modelGroups; VV's loaded groups are categories.
findings.recommendation: Decide D-S09-07. Recommended: a VV single-phase shim at the same path exporting TV's 14 names (one live phase, never borrows), so the LE ports verbatim and real phases can come later.
findings.evidence: shared_import_surface.py: 14 PhaseLibrary names, file absent in VV; TV LoadingSequence:714; VV LoadingSequence:787-876 category groups.

findings.title: ModelToggle lacks BorrowRegistry, RestoreRegistry and SetCategoryVisibleByKey
findings.detail: TV's ModelToggle Controls (13-Sep-2026 entry) lends the category map to a design phase during a Layout Editor render. TV LE SnapshotRenderer imports all three names. VV's ModelToggle Controls 1.2.2 has none of them. VV keeps dispatching na-model-visibility-changed; TV never dispatches it.
findings.recommendation: Add the three exports to VV's ModelToggle (Borrow/Restore may be trivial under a single-phase shim) and keep VV's na-model-visibility-changed dispatch.
findings.evidence: TV ModelToggle:32-37,415,477; shared_import_surface.py lists the 3 names as missing in VV.

findings.title: Door-animation exports missing for TV projected-linework door swings
findings.detail: TV 50/Na__ProjectedLinework__DoorPose__.js imports six Na__DoorAnim__* names from 25 ClickToOpenDoors (ApplyPanelTransform, ComputePanelLocalPose, DescribeDoors, GetLiveProgress, MOD_TYPE_FIXED, MOD_TYPE_ROT_ONLY) and Na__DoorAnimation__FindDoorGroups from a 25 file VV does not have. These support plan door swings and Hide Swings (TV v2.105.0, v2.140.0).

findings.title: 27 ContextMenuSystem is a hidden dependency of the TV Statement Writer
findings.detail: TV 27 (1.0.0) is the 3D right-click menu: it is initialised in Index.html:1609, reset in LoadingSequence:628 and imported by the CSS index:103. TV LE Statement Page and Statement Editor Figure import Na__ContextMenu__Ui__Open/Close from its MenuRenderer. VV has no 27.

findings.evidence: shared_import_surface.py: Ui__Open/Close; TV Index.html:886,1609; TV LoadingSequence:176,628.

findings.title: 21 Na__CfApi__* names imported by TV drawing modules have no VV equivalent
findings.detail: TV 80/Na__CloudflareIntegration__ApiClient__.js 1.5.0 provides IsConfigured, MergeAndSaveKeys, GetLoadedProjectData, ReadProjectData, Read/WriteProjectFile, ProjectFileLocation, AdminFileLocation, PlansFileLocation, Read/WriteStatementFile, StatementFileLocation, Upload/List/DeletePublished, Upload/List/Copy/DeleteSheetImage, SheetImageLocation and SHEET_IMAGES_ARCHIVE. Importers are 40 ProjectData and LE SheetModel__Sheets, ProjectRecord, SpecData, Register, Statement, SheetImages, Publish and ScrapbookParametric.
findings.recommendation: Decide D-S09-04. Recommended: a VV module at the same path with the same 21 signatures, implemented over whitecardopedia-editor-api and WCP Flask under VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/, following the R2AssetUpload precedent. PORT NOTE: diverged, same signature, different transport.
findings.evidence: shared_import_surface.py: 21 names, file absent in VV; TV R2AssetUpload PORT NOTE:14-19 states the same-name-shim rationale.
findings.vv_adaptation: VV worker + Flask; R2 prefix VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/

findings.title: LocalProjectMirror (8 names, drawings save guard) has no VV equivalent
findings.detail: TV 03/Na__AppUtils__LocalProjectMirror__.js 1.2.0 is the localhost half of every TV save. It reads, merges and writes through the ProjectVision server, writes sibling files whole and guards drawings saves (X-TrueVision-Drawings-Base fingerprint, 409 conflict, server backups; TV v2.146.0). It is imported by 40 ProjectData, LE SpecData Lockstep, Register Data/Transactions and Statement Transport/Publish. VV writes R2 then a Flask mirror (R2SaveProjectJson) with no conflict guard or backups.
findings.recommendation: Build a same-name VV shim over WCP Flask. Add Flask routes drawings-fingerprint, backups and generic files/<name> alongside the existing drawing-notes route. Port TV Na__Test__ProjectDataSaveGuard__.test.py, re-targeted at WCP.
findings.evidence: TV LocalProjectMirror:12-48, exports 436-443; NAAPPS server routes 707,728,754; WCP server.py has no equivalents.
findings.vv_adaptation: WCP Flask routes keyed by folderId

findings.title: ProjectLoader lacks GetProjectFolderFromUrl and GetYearFromUrl (12 TV importers)
findings.detail: TV ProjectLoader 2.0.1 derives folder and year from the URL. findings.title: Shared WCP service-worker token not bumped since VV v2.67 although releases added exports

findings.evidence: WCP SW logic:229; VV devlog ~91-94, ~194-197, ~473-479; live_sw.js token 2026-09-10-6.
